_comment: The sales reps used for every per-rep goal, the Program Submissions table, quotas, and commission estimates. Matched to GHL users by userId (the id in GHL's user list); name and email are for readability only. kpiMultiplier scales every per-rep goal rate (1.0 = full-time, 0.5 = part-time); goalOverrides sets a fixed rate for one KPI instead (in the KPI's own unit: per week for weekly goals, per day for daily goals). monthlyQuota is combined submissions for the calendar month. commissionPlan names a plan in config/commission.json. Team-wide goals are the sum of each rep's goal. Everyone not listed here is grouped as 'Other users, not sales reps' and still counts in team totals. Owner decision 2026-10-13 (edits round 6).
